hypothesis_label: Micro acceleration build before expansion as an early intent detector

mechanism_contract.known_baseline_weakness: The baseline can wait for already-obvious expansion and may underweight whether directional pressure was accelerating just before the breakout window.
mechanism_contract.exact_mechanism_of_improvement: Add a micro-acceleration pre-expansion state that distinguishes genuine directional build from flat drift in the immediate lead-up bars.
mechanism_contract.why_not_parameter_tuning: This introduces a new state tied to acceleration shape rather than moving existing thresholds or lookbacks.
mechanism_contract.why_expected_edge_should_survive_strict_: A real signal should generalize as earlier discrimination of launch-ready structures instead of depending on a narrow threshold pick.

required_evidence_inputs: deterministic short-horizon acceleration evidence before expansion
deterministic separation between accelerating lead-in and flat pre-move drift
allowed_scope: new pre-expansion intent state or gate
optional secondary compare against phase68i_dynamic_ladder_candidate for overlay/context suitability only
forbidden_scope: broad slope or momentum parameter sweep shells
